request.recipient: Intersect via the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stated in the on-chain rewards.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, repository management, security initiatives, and management of critical processes for June 2026 to June 2027.

claims.claim: Intersect requests 25,400,000 ada for a June 2026 to June 2027 core operating model covering governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, and critical unowned processes.

The budget is divided into 6,000,000 ada for operations and ecosystem coordination, 18,800,000 ada for technical stewardship and incident response, and 600,000 ada for management of critical processes.
Intersect says the overall ask has been reduced from $7.875M last year to $6.35M while preserving the most critical functions for Cardano continuity and maturity.
Intersect says it has coordinated two network upgrades, is preparing for a third, and led ecosystem coordination during the November 2025 chain partition incident.
The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal states that the requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.

Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with reviews that may include deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.
Intersect and its committees disclose 22,385,000 ada of Cardano Treasury funding received in the past 24 months through three listed governance actions.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, including a 2026 TRSC and one PSSC, with listed stake/payment addresses and specified multi-party authorization thresholds involving Intersect admins, leadership, and six external oversight entities.
A public dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is stated to be available for community auditing and tracking of the withdrawn ada, with activity immutably verifiable on chain.

summary: The document requests 25,400,000 ada for Intersect's 2026-2027 operating, governance, and technical stewardship functions, provides a work-package budget, discloses prior treasury funding, identifies external assurance and smart-contract controls, and points to voting, audit, contract, dashboard, and on-chain references for verification.
